subject.title: Use shared Spark subscription review rails

question: Should this repository authorize the new CLAWSWEEPER_DISPATCH_TOKEN-backed shared Spark review relay to replace the existing native review triggers?
rationale: The repository policy requires separate authorization for secret or permission changes, and that approval cannot be inferred from the contributor's branch or validation claims.

options.title: Authorize after live proof
options.body: Approve the relay only after an authorized owner records approval and the final head supplies redacted successful dispatch evidence.

options.title: Keep existing triggers
options.body: Decline the new secret-backed relay and retain the current separate review-trigger architecture.

recommendation.title: Authorize after live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the relay only after an authorized owner records approval and the final head supplies redacted successful dispatch evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the proposed relay and can provide the technical context while an authorized repository owner makes the approval.
